records.text: The yellow plane with tail number SUBTT stopped for just one hour in Minot, North Dakota on September 4th before making its way to Provo.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: into that one-hour layover stop when our yellow plane, SUBTT—the tail number—came into the United States on September 4th. ... it stopped for just one hour in Minot, North Dakota ... before making its way onto Provo.

verification.notes: Two independent archived ADS-B networks corroborate the route: SU-BTT arrived at Minot from Paris at about 11:03 a.m. local time on September 4, departed about 11:45 a.m., and landed at Provo at 12:46 p.m. The same reconstruction shows Minot was the recurring U.S. customs entry for every Provo-bound foreign rotation in this fleet, which materially weakens a special Valhalla-operation interpretation of the one-hour stop.

sources.title: Minot (KMOT) — April to September 2025: recovered flight record
sources.relevance: Two archived ADS-B networks confirm the September 4 Paris–Minot–Provo leg, the roughly one-hour ground time, and the recurring customs-entry pattern.
